parameters.query: SELECT p.id AS project_id, p.title, p.language, s.id AS scene_id, s.scene_number, s.emotional_tone, s.emotion_cinematography, ch.id AS shot_id, ch.shot_number, ch.shot_type, ch.duration_seconds, ch.description, ch.camera_movement, ch.characters_in_shot, ch.fight_type, ch.fight_intensity, ch.action_description, ch.speed_ramp, ch.camera_angle_override FROM projects p JOIN scenes s ON p.id = s.project_id JOIN shots ch ON s.id = ch.scene_id WHERE p.id = $1 AND p.state IN ('shot_planned', 'fight_choreographed', 'emotion_directed') AND ch.state = 'planned' ORDER BY s.scene_number, ch.shot_number
SELECT b.bible_type, b.content FROM bibles b WHERE b.project_id = $1 AND b.locked = true

INSERT INTO prompts (shot_id, project_id, positive_prompt, negative_prompt, style_keywords, aspect_ratio, quality_tier, seed_suggestion, prompt_version, created_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, $6, $7, $8, $9, NOW())
UPDATE projects SET state = 'prompted', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1
INSERT INTO events (project_id, event_type, payload, created_at) VALUES ($1, 'prompts_built', $2::jsonb, NOW())

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'prompted', project_id: $('Execute Logic (Prompts)').item.json.project_id, total_prompts: $('Execute Logic (Prompts)').item.json.total_prompts }) }}
